description: This file defines the ServicePeriod class, which extends FilterField, and implements logic to add time-based filtering conditions to a query builder. It includes methods to filter based on the number of years an employee has served, using operators like less than, greater than, and between.

classes.name: ServicePeriod
classes.description: A filter field class that adds conditions based on employee service duration for report queries.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds filtering conditions to the query builder based on the selected operator and input values for service period filtering.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias used in query filtering ('employee').
